features: Pro-Grade Night & Dynamic Imaging - Discover breathtaking imaging quality with Osmo Action 5 Pro action camera 4K and its all-new 1/1.3" sensor. Advanced tech with 2.4 μm large pixels and 13.5-stop dynamic range delivers unmatched low-light performance and clarity.

Always Centered, Always Focused - Achieve pinpoint accuracy with our advanced 4nm chip. DJI Osmo Action 5 Pro vlogging camera keeps fast-moving subjects perfectly centered in 16:9 or 9:16—ideal for vlogging, cycling, or capturing friends and pets in action.[7]

360° HorizonSteady [17], Rock-Solid Footage - Industry-leading stabilization eliminates 360° roll-axis shakes, keeping your horizon level and motion smooth. This action camera captures first-person action or scenic landscapes with pro-quality stability.

All-Weather, All-Day Power - Osmo Action 5 Pro underwater camera features a high-capacity 1950mAh battery, providing up to 4 hours [1] of recording, and 3.6 hours at -20° C(-4° F) [9]. IP68 rated for 20m underwater use [8], it delivers clear footage in any environment.

Dual OLED Touchscreens, Maximum Control - Front and rear ultra-bright OLED touchscreens make framing, playback, and parameter adjustment easy—ideal for motorcycle camera use. Enjoy crystal-clear visuals without removing the action camera.
Go Hands-Free with Voice Control - With voice commands always on standby [15], enjoy optimal recognition within one meter and high accuracy—making it easy to capture every moment while having fun.

Pro Audio, Effortless Vlogging - DJI Osmo Action 5 Pro supports direct wireless connection to DJI Mic 2/Mic mini transmitter—no RX needed—perfect for moto vlogging, skiing, solo-vlogging. Enjoy pure, high-quality audio!

True-to-Life Color in Any Light - Equipped with a color temperature sensor for automatic white balance, DJI Action 5 Pro delivers natural, accurate colors—underwater or on land—no filters needed. Flicker-free, smooth transitions in any lighting.
Choose Your Combo - Adventure Combo has a 1.5m Extension Rod, 3 batteries (2 more than Standard), and a multifunctional battery case.
